description: This source file contains a suite of unit tests for Orleans grain streaming functionality, specifically testing support for IAsyncEnumerable<T> methods. It verifies streaming behaviors such as batching, error handling, cancellation, slow producers/consumers, and resource cleanup, including deactivation and enumerator eviction scenarios. The tests also include diagnostic listeners to monitor internal cleanup operations.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerableGrainCallTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies Orleans' support for async enumerable streaming, including batching, error handling, cancellation, slow producers/consumers, and resource cleanup scenarios.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerableGrainExtensionListener
classes.description: A diagnostic listener class used within tests to monitor internal cleanup operations of async enumerators in Orleans streaming extension.

methods.name: ObservableGrain_AsyncEnumerable
methods.description: Tests basic streaming of values from a grain using IAsyncEnumerable, verifying correct data transmission and disposal.

methods.name: ObservableGrain_AsyncEnumerable_Throws
methods.description: Tests error propagation during streaming when an exception is thrown during enumeration.

methods.name: ObservableGrain_AsyncEnumerable_Cancellation
methods.description: Verifies proper handling of cancellation during streaming when the grain cancels enumeration.

methods.name: ObservableGrain_AsyncEnumerable_CancellationToken
methods.description: Tests client-side cancellation via CancellationToken during streaming.

methods.name: ObservableGrain_AsyncEnumerable_CancellationToken_WithCancellationExtension
methods.description: Tests client-side cancellation using the WithCancellation extension method.

methods.name: ObservableGrain_AsyncEnumerable_Batch
methods.description: Verifies automatic batching of streamed values to optimize network usage.

methods.name: ObservableGrain_AsyncEnumerable_SplitBatch
methods.description: Tests custom batch size configuration for streaming.

methods.name: ObservableGrain_AsyncEnumerable_NoBatching
methods.description: Verifies streaming with batch size set to 1, resulting in one network call per value.

methods.name: ObservableGrain_AsyncEnumerable_WithCancellation
methods.description: Tests client-side cancellation during active streaming.

methods.name: ObservableGrain_AsyncEnumerable_SlowProducer
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the grain produces values slowly, ensuring client can stop early.

methods.name: ObservableGrain_AsyncEnumerable_SlowConsumer
methods.description: Ensures that slow-consuming clients do not cause premature cleanup of enumerators.

methods.name: ObservableGrain_AsyncEnumerable_SlowConsumer_Evicted
methods.description: Tests resource cleanup when a slow client is evicted after a timeout.

methods.name: ObservableGrain_AsyncEnumerable_Deactivate
methods.description: Verifies that deactivating a grain during enumeration terminates streaming with an error.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerableGrainExtensionListener
methods.description: A diagnostic listener class that monitors internal cleanup events of async enumerators for testing purposes.
